name: contract-desensitizer-offline
title_zh: 合同脱敏后还能一键还原，编号全文对得上
tagline_zh: 发给外部律师或外包前，先把甲乙方、金额、身份证号换成统一编号占位符，同一实体全文一致；原件不出本机。
tagline_en: Before sending a contract out, swap names, amounts and IDs for consistent numbered placeholders — fully offline.
desc_en: 本地离线合同脱敏与还原：识别并替换敏感信息为全文编号一致的可逆占位符，生成 mapping.json 支持一键还原， 支持 docx/pdf/txt/md，完全离线。触发词：合同脱敏、合同去隐私、协议脱敏、合同还原、文档脱敏。
why_zh: 占位符是全文编号一致的，不是逐处随机替换，所以读起来仍像一份完整合同。
why_en: Placeholders are numbered consistently across the whole file, so it still reads like a real contract; restore is driven by.
limit_zh: 只做文本层替换：扫描件 PDF 没有文字层就识别不出，需要先自己 OCR；还原依赖 mapping.json。
limit_en: Text-layer only: scanned PDFs without a text layer need OCR first. Restore requires mapping.json — lose it and you keep the placeholder version.
title_en: Offline contract redaction with one-click restore
